name: Sprite Atlas to 3D
description: Loads a sprite atlas (multiple frames/angles of the same character) as input and reconstructs a 3D mesh that takes into account every view angle in the sheet.
author: krasorx

params_schema.label: Columns
params_schema.tooltip: Number of columns in the sprite atlas grid.

params_schema.label: Rows
params_schema.tooltip: Number of rows in the sprite atlas grid.

params_schema.label: Background Color
params_schema.tooltip: How to treat the background of each frame before reconstruction.

params_schema.label: View Order
params_schema.tooltip: Order in which frames are assigned an azimuth angle.

params_schema.label: Sample Size
params_schema.tooltip: Pixel size each frame is normalized to before reconstruction.

params_schema.label: Voxel Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Resolution of the volumetric reconstruction grid. Higher = more detail but slower.

params_schema.label: Colorize
params_schema.tooltip: Bake per-vertex color from the atlas frames.
